data.case_title: Hearing aid invoice from Hörakustik Beispielklang
data.explanation: Your hearing aid acoustician has billed you for your personal share of the cost of your new hearing systems, after your health insurer paid its fixed-rate contribution. The amount of €1,400.00 is due within 30 days of the invoice date shown on the bill. Pay it by the deadline shown by transferring it to the IBAN given, using the invoice number as reference. If you cannot pay the full amount at once, the letter says instalment payment can be arranged with the provider directly. Keep this invoice, as medical/hearing-related expenses can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary expenses on your tax return.
